$comment: ADR-007 rule 4, as data: attribute names that must never be shipped to the
log store. Content and credentials belong in a store with an access model;
this one answers unauthenticated with the OpenSearch security plugin
disabled. Identity attributes are excluded too — the reader drops user@*
and organization@*, so emitting them ships PII nobody reads back.
Matched as SUBSTRINGS, case-insensitively, so a near-miss name is caught
rather than squeaking past an exact-match list: note_content, access_token
Why a contract file rather than a shared module: the two consumers cannot
import from each other. brainbox is an installed package; the Drive inbox
runs as a standalone `uv run --script` whose sys.path is its own directory.
So the CODE is duplicated by necessity and the POLICY is not — each
consumer carries a conformance test that fails if its copy drifts from
this file. Duplicating a security guard without that check is how one copy
Adding an entry here fails both suites until both copies are updated,
which is the intended workflow — widen the policy, then widen the code.
